backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister with user profiles, habit creation, completion tracking, volume tracking, and access control.
backend/migration.mo: Provides migration logic that maps old habit data to the new format, resetting volume tracking structures safely.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence for monthly volume progression rules for Plank and Squash and the related frontend files affected.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files, covering components, state logic, styling, and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Defines global CSS variables and tailwind base styles for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app at the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wrapper setting up QueryClient, layout, authentication UI, BecomingView, footer, and toasts.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting users to log in with Internet Identity to access habit data.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing whether the user is currently authenticated.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout actions with state-aware button behavior.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating habit data, handling authentication state, actor readiness, caching, and error normalization.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main view that handles auth, loading, and error states before rendering the habit manager, month tabs, and habit grid.
Displays a styled error message with an optional retry button using user-friendly error text.
Renders a full-page skeleton placeholder mimicking the habit grid layout while data loads.
Modal form for editing habit name, unit type, and monthly volume with validation and mutation calls.
Displays the habits grid with day columns and individual habit rows, handling empty states.
Defines layout constants and helper functions for sizing and generating grid columns for the habit grid.
UI for adding new habits with inline input mode and mutation handling.
Renders a single habit row with info, volume, completion checkboxes, and edit controls.
Popover menu attached to habit info for triggering habit editing.
Renders tab controls for selecting months using a predefined 2026 month list.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Provides 2026 month metadata and utilities to fetch month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Builds habit completion maps, checks completion status, and formats volume/time data for habits.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Validates, parses, formats, and normalizes time strings in minutes and seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Creates an actor with timeout and error handling, providing manual retry and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and identity persistence via a React context provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styling, color variables, and touch-optimized utilities for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, QueryClient, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Provides helpers to normalize errors, detect stopped-canister IC replica errors, and return user-friendly fallback messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters (including hash routing), storing them in sessionStorage, and managing persisted parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and plugins such as typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing required fixes for monthly time progression logic, including Plank and Squash rules and related feature requests.
